question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Accuse
solution:
The correct answer is **'Defend'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accuse"** means to claim that someone has done something illegal or wrong, often without proof. **(आरोप लगाना)**

 
 
• Example: She **accused** him of stealing her purse.
 
 
 
• The most appropriate antonym of "Accuse" is ''Defend''
 
• **"Defend"** means to stand up for or protect someone from harm or criticism. **(किसी को हानि या आलोचना से बचाना).**
 
 
• Example: He** defended** his friend against the accusations
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Incriminate:** Implicate in guilt or wrongdoing; to make someone appear guilty. **(दोषी ठहराना)**
 
• **Charge**: To formally accuse someone of a crime**.(किसी पर औपचारिक रूप से अपराध का आरोप लगाना)**
 
• **Allege**: To assert something as a fact without providing complete evidence** (किसी बात को पूरा सबूत दिए बिना तथ्य के रूप में दावा करना)**
